scientific_integrity: The infinite assertion is proved by parity of prime/composite transitions, explicit five-step evaluation, and disjointness of states; finite enumerations only independently check the derivation. Earlier prime-shift orbit results and their limits are credited.
scientific_limitations: Only positive odd shifts are classified. Periods larger than five and the infinitude of admissible parameters are not resolved; bibliographic equivalence outside the inspected primary and indexed sources cannot be excluded.
title: Odd-cycle rigidity and the exact five-cycle criterion for a prime-shift map
